'''Josh Hagen''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 7th at [[January 2001 St. Cloud tournament]] in January 2001, according to Michael Raveling's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1648">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-21-st-cloud-2001d1648/ st-cloud-2001], DeckTech (Michael "Gilliatt" Raveling, 21 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-21-st-cloud-2001d1648/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
